questions.prompt: Why does this track want local on every variable a function creates?

options.b: without it, every assignment lands in the caller's namespace — the function silently edits the world that called it
options.c: bash requires it in strict mode

questions.prompt: A function must hand back a hostname (a string). Which design?

options.b: echo it and let the caller capture with $(fn) — return moves one byte of verdict, never text

questions.prompt: `if is_healthy "$n"; then` — what exactly does if consume?

options.b: the function's return/exit code — same as any command (pulse.sh, L1.6)
